title: Applied statistics 101 in R: One-way Repeated Measures Analysis of Variance
content: Repeated measures ANOVA is the statistical method for comparing means of the same sample measured at least two different times, or two different contexts. It may also be used to compare means between two or more related groups. This paper serves as a tutorial for repeated measures ANOVA using R. It will introduce readers to parametric, nonparametric and robust one-way repeated measures ANOVA using the rstatix, afex, WRS2, and ARTool packages.
